description_en: Deletes live snapshot files. You can delete only the records, or both the records and the original Object Storage Service (OSS) files
description_zh: 调用DeleteLiveSnapshotFiles删除实时截图文件，可选择只删除记录或同时删除原始OSS文件
name: DeleteLiveSnapshotFiles

parameters.description_en: The ID of the snapshot job.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the snapshot job

parameters.description_en: A list of creation timestamps for the files to delete. You can specify up to 200 timestamps per request.
